payload.notes: Coordinates A–E are program-owned and not redefined here, so the file compiles only when the program inserts those \coordinate lines at the start of the tikzpicture. Edges: AB, BC, CD, AE, ED (the AD line split at E), BE, CE, all solid, drawn between named coordinates. No right-angle mark, since CV and the Critic verified none and the BE/AD perpendicularity is not drawn as a mark. No label J, since it is an unbound OCR misread of B. Stroke width 0.8pt with round joins from STYLE METRICS. Labels use the metrics font (16.5/19.8 pt) in math mode, placed outside each vertex.

Repair: E label changed from [above right] to [below right], still bound to (E). AD has slope +1 through E, so the lower-right quadrant at E is clear of AD, BE and CE. The critic's [right] option would also work. All other edges, labels, line width (0.8pt) and label font (16.5/19.8) are unchanged. No J label or right-angle mark added. Per the PROGRAM-OWNED CV COORDINATES block, the coordinate definitions for A-E are not emitted here; the program inserts them. The earlier inline definitions differed from the program values by about 0.001, so I used the program's frame. No measurement problems were found in the program block, so nothing needs remeasurement.
